claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: Witness shows a white vertical console and one white controller but does not read brand or model.
Photos show the console's appearance but not usage history or close-up wear.
Internal condition and seals are not visible in the photos.
Thermal behavior cannot be observed from still photos.
Port functionality requires physical testing not shown in photos.
Witness shows one white controller but cannot confirm it is original or that multiple pads are included.
No receipt appears in the photos and its origin cannot be verified remotely.

risks.proof: Video of the controller syncing and all buttons responding

Clip of a disc being inserted and a game running

response.reason: The witness identifies a white vertical game console with a controller, so it can be priced at its worst case; the PS5 slim model and working condition are unproven and would require proof to raise the value.
